note: Names, descriptions and grades are the 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (reported by Push Square, GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer). Rockstar, Sony and Microsoft have not published the list themselves. Guides are written in our own words; each cites its sources. Five trophies were still unconfirmed at launch — their guides say so honestly instead of inventing a method.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is nothing extra to do — it is the reward for finishing the whole list, so work through the roadmap below and it will be the last trophy you earn.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it unlocks when the mission ends. You cannot miss it — just finish the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish Chapter 1. Keep playing the main story and it pops at the end of the chapter — no side content needed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish Chapter 2. Keep playing the main story; it pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the main story; it pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish Chapter 4. Keep playing the main story; it pops at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish the final mission at the end of the story. Play the main story to the end and it pops with the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Story only — play the mission and it unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Story only — play the mission and it unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Story only — play the mission and it unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Story only — play the mission and it unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Story only — play the mission and it unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic when you finish the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only — play the mission and it unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — it appears after the story. The list is lenient, roughly 60% of true completion: any 100 optional missions, scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars, finish any 70 of the 80 challenges, and complete 300 stunts. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable, so clean it up in free-roam after the credits.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 parachute base jumps. Mix the categories and pick what is quickest for you — flying under bridges is the fastest to rack up. Track progress per region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress, then Activities, to see which types you have done. Most come naturally during the story and cleanup, so do not chase this one — it will pop on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The medals are not too hard — take your time, use a steady weapon, and work through each range's challenges one by one.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races exist in total, but you only need one win per location, not every race.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the 40 unique race locations. Each location only counts once, so move on to a new location after each win instead of repeating one you already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once — beating every challenge is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3 Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville, which marks the questline on the map. Finish her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. Still available after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams; he calls, then is marked KR in Key Lento. Dive for his treasures — 7 shipwrecks in total, marked with purple chest icons — and bring them back to him, using the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a while in Chapters 2 to 3 but comes back, so nothing is missable.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain strangers count — confirmed ones include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), and Pilot Pete (deliveries); more qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the in-game trophy counter as you go. Named side characters like Moses, Tyrone, Andy, Billy, and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. All strands stay available after the story, and the trophy tracker shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants — he marks some on the map, and scanning a car with the WAiNK app shows whether it is on the list. Deliver in good condition for more money.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives you the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down for good. Available after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING — the only trophy reported as possibly missable: a Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house. In the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen and walks out to the balcony — follow her, talk to her, and accept. It is not yet confirmed whether that one is required for the trophy, so do it while you can.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — Jason gets a text marking the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it). Do the first quest, then Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back as Jason. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle in the first quest. There are 15 Target Decks, all needed for 100% completion. Which animal exactly triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed, so work through the decks and it should come along the way.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida — collect the cards for any 3 full sets and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone's WAiNK app — hold Up, then R1, to scan. Landmarks, curiosities, sculptures, and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more than 100 of them, so scan whatever you pass while playing.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You need 70 for 100% completion, so this pops on the way there. Check Progress, then Challenges, for what is done, then pick the easiest remaining ones — most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside — available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call them to join you — build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. Leaving only the flashing search area is not enough; you must get out of the red heat zone itself. A fast motorcycle cutting through traffic works well; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because helicopters cannot follow you onto the tracks. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, when bank vaults give you 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, with your partner with you, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level — stay in the flashing red-and-blue wanted state between shops, not the red heat level, and do not lose the cops. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, once Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs has unlocked them. Loot properly in each store and break the safe with sticky bombs; if it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth. The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the last shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app on your phone and scan vehicles as they pass — stand on a busy road and scan everything new. You only need to scan them, not drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so this comes naturally.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — press L3 and R3 together while aiming a firearm. It slows time and drains the purple focus bar, so buff focus first with food, drinks, or Adrenaline, and level focus up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, and headshots. Line up 5 enemies — gang operation crews work well — and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police, or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. Planes parked on the open airfield do not count; it must be one connected to a boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in, and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies. Break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it — kicking trips the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe without being detected. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his Payday Loans quests) to find more vaults. Robbing a vault gives 4 stars instantly — escape on a fast bike. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat radius. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since robbing the bank vault counts as robbing the truck. An earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door, grab the cash, and escape the red heat zone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida — fly a plane over every blacked-out area until the whole map is visible. A plane is the fastest way to cover the state.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist in total, and all 39 are needed for 100% completion. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through the story. Track per-gang progress under Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as unknown. GTABase reads the description as having a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City, and says the exact steps are not confirmed yet. Check the linked guides for updates as players pin it down. Do not trust unverified methods posted elsewhere.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch — PowerPyx and GTABase both list this trophy's method as unknown. The description points to smashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, in classic style; check the linked guides for updates as players pin it down.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You first go there in the Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength (heart icon). Work out together — call your partner so the other trains automatically while you work out — at fitness clubs around Vice City, or at home after the story. You can only switch between both characters after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — robberies, fights, and escapes all count. Turn on criminal-profile notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, to see a demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile by not going overboard with violence against cops and civilians. It mostly happens passively while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and GTABase suggests it is about succeeding at something on the second attempt. Treat both as leads, not facts, and check the linked guides for updates.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed by any text guide — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as unknown, believed to be tied to a UFO questline. One video report (linked) describes a UFO encounter in Kelly County after 2am: a car at the roadside with flickering lights, then a UFO up the road and a stranger to speak to. Treat the video method as unconfirmed until a text guide verifies it, and check the linked guides for updates.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as unknown, believed to be a melee drive-by while kicking enemies from a motorcycle, and GTABase reads it the same way: knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle, exact steps not confirmed yet. Treat both as leads, not facts, and check the linked guides for updates.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods, and tattoos are the fastest way to get there because they cost the most. Any shop spending counts toward the total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — $160,000 in total — through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages do not count, only the 8 you buy. Robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 are the fastest money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) for parking spots, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. He only takes vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
